text: Nobody tells you what Rama's fourteen years teach investors. One lakh became twenty six lakh.
November twenty twelve. One Thunga my eel share cost about three hundred twenty six rupees. One lakh bought around three hundred seven shares.
In twenty twenty three, a one for one bonus doubled them, to six hundred fourteen shares.
Today, at four thousand three hundred forty four rupees, that's about twenty six point seven lakh. Twenty six times your money.
The same lakh in the Nifty fifty? About four and a half lakh.
But like any exile, it wasn't easy. This year alone, the stock fell forty two percent from its peak.
Patience is the real return. Could you hold for fourteen years? Comment fourteen, and follow for more.
